desc:
Shopify order management setup gives every order a clear path from payment to delivery. Ecom Swift LLC builds the tags, filters and written steps for fulfilment, refunds and exchanges, and then works your first batch of open orders with you.

## What is Shopify order management?

Shopify order management is the way your team handles each order after a customer pays. It covers checking the order, preparing and shipping it, adding tracking, answering questions and dealing with refunds, returns and exchanges.

Shopify gives you the Orders screen and the tools. A routine is what turns those tools into something reliable. Without one, each order depends on who is working that day and what they remember.

## Why order handling goes wrong

Orders get stuck for ordinary reasons. A payment sits unfulfilled, a partial shipment is forgotten, tracking is never added, or a refund request waits in an inbox. The customer sees silence, and silence becomes a complaint or a chargeback.

Growth makes it worse. A routine that works for five orders a week breaks at fifty. Staff members handle things differently, and nobody can say which orders need attention right now.

## How a clear order workflow supports your business

Customers judge a store by what happens after checkout. A prompt shipping email with tracking, a clear return process and fast answers build repeat business. A slow or confusing process pushes buyers to competitors the next time.

For you, a workflow means less stress and fewer mistakes. Tags and saved filters show which orders need action. Written steps mean a new team member can follow the same process. Automations take over repetitive steps, so your time goes to the exceptions. Results depend on your products and carriers, but a tidy process removes avoidable errors.

## What good order management includes

- A review of open and stuck orders, so nothing old is lost.
- A tagging system for status, such as awaiting stock, ready to ship or needs contact.
- Saved filters in the Orders screen for each status.
- Written fulfilment steps, including how tracking is added.
- Written steps for refunds, exchanges and partial shipments.
- Shipping and confirmation email wording reviewed for clarity.
- Return and exchange page text drafted for your store.
- Automations for repeat steps, such as tagging an order by rule.
- Fraud and risk settings checked.
- A short hand-off guide for your staff.

## What we do

We join your store as staff and start with the orders already open. We list the ones that are stuck and agree with you which action each one needs. Then we build the tag set and filters so your Orders screen reads as a clear to-do list.

Next we write the fulfilment, refund and exchange steps in your words and for your carriers. On the Standard package we process a batch of real open orders during the sprint, set up the first automations and review your shipping email text. Premium handles a larger batch, adds more automations, checks fraud and risk settings, and ends with a guide for your staff. Refunds are processed in your own Shopify and payment account, and any customer message is sent with your approval. We do not ship parcels, since packing stays with you or your warehouse.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Keep one tag name for one meaning, and write it down.
- Add tracking to every shipped order the same day.
- Answer return requests with the same clear steps each time.
- Review stuck orders at a fixed time every week.
- Tell us your carrier and your usual dispatch time.

**Avoid:**
- Using free-form tags that nobody else understands.
- Refunding an order before checking whether it was shipped.
- Leaving partial shipments without a note to the customer.
- Ignoring fraud flags on large or unusual orders.
- Changing the process without updating the written steps.

## Who this is for

This service suits owners who are overwhelmed by orders arriving faster than they can track. It suits stores that have just hired a first helper and need a process they can hand over, and it suits sellers with a pile of old unfulfilled orders. It is a setup and first-batch service. Daily order handling is quoted separately.

## What we need from you

We need a staff invitation to your Shopify store, your return and shipping policy as it stands today and the name of your carrier. Tell us who may contact customers and who approves refunds. We never need your password or card details. After you order, we send a short checklist and confirm which orders we will work first.
